name: mermaid
description: Create and render Mermaid diagrams via CLI using the CLI-Anything mermaid harness. Supports flowcharts, sequence diagrams, class diagrams, state diagrams, ER diagrams, Gantt charts. Renders via mermaid.ink cloud service. Hybrid invocation. Use when creating text-based diagrams; when the user asks to visualize as mermaid. Do NOT use for Draw.io diagrams or pixel-based images.

locked: Harness location: MERMAID_HARNESS or repository-relative mermaid/agent-harness/
